    • emitVertexGeomCode

      public void emitVertexGeomCode(Formatter vs, @NonNull String worldPosVar, @Nullable String localPosVar, boolean useStepSolidColor)
      Description copied from class: GeometryStep
      Emits the geometry code into the vertex shader. Implementation must define "vec4 worldPosVar" with the given name and setup it. If localPosVar is not null, then it must write geometry's local pos to it.
      Specified by:

    • emitFragmentColorCode

      public void emitFragmentColorCode(Formatter fs, String outputColor)
      Description copied from class: GeometryStep
      Emits the fragment color code into the fragment shader. This is either paint's solid color or per-vertex primitive color. See GeometryStep.FLAG_HANDLE_SOLID_COLOR and GeometryStep.FLAG_EMIT_PRIMITIVE_COLOR.
